analyst.summary: Voltas is India's leading room air-conditioner brand, but FY26 profit nearly halved even as the stock continues to trade at a very rich valuation. While India's long-term air-conditioning demand growth remains a genuine tailwind, this year's sharp earnings decline - driven by margin pressure and a weak quarter in the company's projects business - has not been reflected in the share price, which still prices in near-flawless execution.
